scope: NativeHost mouse/touch/scroll input wrapper tracks editable focus owner during active composition; handler tests without OS window
reproduced: Pointer press switched editable focus from0 to1 but left composing=true.
implementation: Compare editable focus before/after the input callback. A changed or missing owner clears preedit and host composing. When not composing, delegate directly without tracking. Pointer/touch batches keep their original single NativeApp update.

checks: Hover over another editor preserves composition and focus
Subsequent edit updates new target only
Hover over blank area preserves session
Click blank area retires session without model changes

limits: No actual OS IME or pointer event injection
Same-editor caret selection/drag matrix remains open
Model replacement after NativeApp callback and backend/window switches remain open
